name: David B. Mishael
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Coconut Grove, Florida
education: University of Florida Levin College of Law
about: In the vibrant community of Coconut Grove, Florida, attorney David B. Mishael leads his firm, David B. Mishael, P.A., with a focus on handling catastrophic cases. His competence lies in navigating the complexities of electrical and construction accidents, often involving wrongful death and severe injuries. In addition to his Florida-based work, he maintains a national practice, representing clients across the United States in high-stakes litigation.

Known for his dedication to achieving substantial results, Mr. Mishael typically manages cases with outcomes starting at $600,000, ensuring that each client receives the highest level of trial representation across both state and federal courts nationwide. His unwavering commitment to justice sets him apart in the legal field.

Mr. Mishael's journey into law began after he completed his undergraduate studies at the University of Florida in 1980. He then pursued his legal education at the University of Florida Levin College of Law, graduating in 1983. That same year, he passed the bar exam and began practicing law in Florida. His professional excellence is recognized by an AV Preeminent peer-review rating* through Martindale-Hubbell.

In 2011, Mr. Mishael was honored by Florida Trend magazine as one of the "Top Attorneys and Legal Leaders." He has also received the prestigious Golden Eagle and Silver Eagle awards from the Florida Justice Association, reflecting his success in handling hundreds of complex litigation cases.

A respected figure in the legal community, Mr. Mishael actively participates in several professional organizations, including the Dade County Bar Association, the American Bar Association, The Florida Bar, the American Justice Association, the Florida Justice Association, the Dade County Trial Lawyers Association and the Broward County Trial Lawyers Association. His involvement underscores his commitment to the legal profession and his relentless pursuit of justice for his clients.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
